0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_DEFAULT_TALK_1
0.description: Greetings! I take it you have come to see me about a retainer.
0.translation_description: Salve! Immagino tu sia qui per parlarmi di un servitore.

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_DEFAULT_TALK_2
1.description: Retainers are hardworking lads and lasses who will help you to manage those spoils earned while off slaying dragons or whatever it is you adventurers do.
1.translation_description: I servitori sono uomini e donne laboriosi che ti aiutano a gestire il bottino accumulato mentre vai in giro a caccia di draghi o ti dedichi a qualunque altra attività da avventuriero.

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_DEFAULT_TALK_3
2.description: Unfortunately, you do not appear you could even slay an eft, let alone a dragon, therefore I must decline any petition you may have to take a retainer into your employ.
2.translation_description: Purtroppo non sembri nemmeno in grado di abbattere un eft, figuriamoci un drago. Devo quindi respingere qualsiasi richiesta di assumere un servitore.

3.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_DEFAULT_TALK_4
3.description: Build yourself a reputation in this city, however, and I shall provide you with whatever it is you need. Might I suggest you start by heading back to the Adventurers' Guild and seeing if someone there has work for you?
3.translation_description: Se però ti farai una reputazione in città, ti procurerò ciò che ti serve. Ti suggerisco di tornare alla Gilda degli Avventurieri e chiedere se hanno qualche incarico per te.

22.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_EXPLANATION_MENU_ABOUT
22.translation_description: Quali servizi possono offrire i servitori?

23.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_EXPLANATION_MENU_CALL
23.description: How do I summon a retainer?

25.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ABOUT_TALK_01
25.description: Retainers are men and women who offer their services in exchange for coin. Though they're seldom as sharp as adventurers like yourself, they're no strangers to life's more menial tasks─tasks which your lot might not think worth your time.
25.translation_description: I servitori sono uomini e donne che offrono i propri servizi in cambio di gil. Anche se raramente sono svegli quanto avventurieri come te, non sono estranei agli incarichi più umili─incarichi che forse non ritieni degni del tuo tempo.

26.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ABOUT_TALK_02
26.description: Retainers can provide a host of different services, from tending your items to protecting your gil. Oh, and you need not worry about providing recompense for a retainer's services, for the Adventurers' Guild will not only cover his salary, but also replace anything that goes missing, should you wake up to find your belongings gone and your retainer nowhere to be found.
26.translation_description: I servitori possono occuparsi di molte cose, dalla gestione dei tuoi oggetti alla custodia dei tuoi gil. E non devi preoccuparti di pagarli: la Gilda degli Avventurieri coprirà il loro salario e sostituirà qualsiasi cosa dovesse sparire, nel caso ti svegliassi senza più i tuoi averi e senza trovare il tuo servitore.

27.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ITEMS_GIL_TALK_01
27.description: Another job retainers are often asked to perform is the tending of items placed up for sale in the markets─something many adventurers cannot be bothered to do themselves.
27.translation_description: Un altro incarico affidato spesso ai servitori è gestire gli oggetti messi in vendita nei mercati, cosa di cui molti avventurieri non vogliono occuparsi da soli.

28.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ITEMS_GIL_TALK_02
28.description: If you wish to experience the market for yourself, I ask that you seek out one of the nearby boards.
28.translation_description: Se vuoi provare il mercato, ti consiglio di rivolgerti a una delle bacheche qui vicino.

29.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CALL_TALK_01
29.description: Retainers in your employ can be summoned at any time using special bells like the one nearby.
29.translation_description: Puoi evocare i servitori che hai assunto in qualsiasi momento usando campanelle speciali, come quella qui vicino.

30.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CALL_TALK_02
30.description: Summoning bells can also be found around the realm in oft-visited locations such as city markets and inns.
30.translation_description: Le campanelle si trovano anche in tutto il regno, nei luoghi più frequentati come i mercati cittadini e le locande.

57.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CASHBACK_EXPLANATION
57.description: To make their markets more attractive to prospective sellers, cities will often lower the percentage of tax that is collected from each sale.
57.translation_description: Per rendere i mercati più attraenti per chi vuole vendere, le città spesso riducono la percentuale di tasse riscossa su ogni vendita.

58.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CASHBACK_CAUTION
58.description: Reduced tax rate periods can end earlier than indicated if areas require maintenance.
58.translation_description: I periodi con aliquota ridotta possono terminare prima del previsto se alcune zone necessitano di manutenzione.

59.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CREATE_TALK_01
59.description: According to our records, you may hire up to <hex:022003E80203> retainers.
59.translation_description: Secondo i nostri registri, puoi assumere fino a <hex:022003E80203> servitori.

60.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_NO_RETAINERS_TALK
60.description: Currently, you have no retainers in your employ.
60.translation_description: Al momento non hai nessun servitore alle tue dipendenze.

61.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_HAVE_RETAINERS_TALK
61.description: Currently, you have <hex:022003E80203> <hex:02081AE4E80202FF0972657461696E6572FF0A72657461696E65727303> in your employ.
61.translation_description: Al momento hai <hex:022003E80203> <hex:02081BE4E80202FF0A7365727669746F7265FF0A7365727669746F726903> alle tue dipendenze.

62.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CUSTOMIZE_WARNING
62.description: While customizing your retainer, you will be unable to communicate with players and engage in other activities.
62.translation_description: Mentre personalizzi il tuo servitore, non potrai comunicare con altri giocatori né svolgere altre attività.

63.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CUSTOMIZE_TALK
63.description: Excellent. We have quite a few men and women on our lists, so I invite you to describe the retainer you desire, down to the most minute detail.
63.translation_description: Ottimo. Abbiamo molti uomini e donne nei nostri registri, quindi descrivimi nel dettaglio il servitore che desideri.

64.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_DUTY_FINDER_WARNING
64.description: Beginning the retainer customization process will automatically cancel your Duty Finder registration.
64.translation_description: Avviare la personalizzazione del servitore annullerà automaticamente la tua registrazione alla Ricerca Incarichi.

65.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_DUTY_FINDER_CONFIRM
65.description: Withdraw duty registration and hire a retainer?
65.translation_description: Annullare la registrazione agli Incarichi e assumere un servitore?

66.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_PERSONALITY_TALK
66.description: I can think of several retainers that are exactly as you describe. Oddly enough, they have strikingly different personalities. If you would be so kind as to state a preference, it would be most helpful.
66.translation_description: Credo di poterti indicare diversi servitori che corrispondono esattamente alla tua descrizione. Curiosamente, hanno personalità molto diverse. Se mi indicassi una preferenza, mi saresti d'aiuto.

74.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CHECK_PERSONALITY_ENTER
74.description: Very well, I have just the individual in mind. When summoned, this retainer will greet you just so:
74.translation_description: Benissimo, ho già in mente la persona giusta. Quando lo evocherai, questo servitore ti saluterà così:

75.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CHECK_PERSONALITY_LEAVE
75.description: And when dismissed, this retainer will bid you farewell just so:
75.translation_description: E quando lo congedi, ti saluterà così:

77.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_NAME_ASK
77.description: Excellent. It is also customary to give a retainer an appellation of one's own making─a nickname, as it were. We find this deepens the bond between our clients and their retainers.
77.translation_description: Ottimo. È consuetudine dare al servitore un appellativo scelto da te, una sorta di soprannome. Crediamo che questo rafforzi il legame tra i nostri clienti e i loro servitori.

79.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_NAME_PROMPT_MESSAGE0
79.translation_description: Dai un soprannome al tuo servitore.

80.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_NAME_PROMPT_MESSAGE1
80.description: Names must be at least 3 characters long and can contain letters, apostrophes, and hyphens. Please note, however, that hyphens cannot be used in succession or placed immediately before or after apostrophes.
80.translation_description: Il nome deve contenere almeno 3 caratteri e può includere lettere, apostrofi e trattini. I trattini non possono essere consecutivi né comparire subito prima o dopo un apostrofo.

82.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CANCEL_CONFIRM
82.description: Are you certain you wish to cancel the hiring process?
82.translation_description: Sei sicuro di voler annullare la procedura di assunzione?

87.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CREATING_RETAINER
87.description: One moment, please, while I draft the proper documentation.
87.translation_description: Un momento, per favore: preparo i documenti necessari.

88.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CREATE_SUCCESS_01
88.description: Congratulations! <hex:022B09FF07022903EA020303> is now in your employ.
88.translation_description: Complimenti! <hex:022B09FF07022903EA020303> ora è alle tue dipendenze.

89.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CREATE_SUCCESS_02
89.description: You can summon your new retainer using the nearby bell.
89.translation_description: Puoi evocare il nuovo servitore usando la campanella qui vicino.

90.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CREATE_SUCCESS_03
90.description: If you have any further questions or requests, please do not hesitate to ask.
90.translation_description: Non esitare a rivolgerti a me per altre domande o richieste.

91.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_CREATE_FAILED_NAME
91.description: The name you have chosen is not available. Please select another.
91.translation_description: Il nome scelto non è disponibile. Scegline un altro.

92.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_CREATE_FULL
92.description: I am sorry, but you cannot hire any more retainers.
92.translation_description: Mi dispiace, ma non puoi assumere altri servitori.

93.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_CREATE_CANCEL
93.description: Understood. If you change your mind, speak with me again.
93.translation_description: D'accordo. Se cambi idea, parlami di nuovo.

124.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_REMAKE_RETAINER_EXPLANATION
124.description: You...are dissatisfied with one of your retainers? Very well. If you would be so kind as to inform me which retainer is lacking, we can begin the review process.
124.translation_description: Sei... insoddisfatto di uno dei tuoi servitori? D'accordo. Dimmi quale non ti soddisfa, così avvieremo la procedura di revisione.

125.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_REMAKE_RETAINER_TALK
125.description: You may change your retainers' nicknames or instruct them to visit the aesthetician at any time. If you desire more drastic changes to a retainer's appearance or personality, the retainer vocate will assist you in finding a replacement of comparable skill and experience.
125.translation_description: Puoi cambiare il soprannome dei tuoi servitori o chiedere loro di andare dall'estetista in qualsiasi momento. Se desideri modifiche più radicali all'aspetto o alla personalità di un servitore, il mediatore dei servitori ti aiuterà a trovare un sostituto con capacità ed esperienza analoghe.

129.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_REMAKE_CANCEL
129.description: Then you <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> completely satisfied with your retainer? Understood. Pray speak with me again should your preferences change.
129.translation_description: Allora il tuo servitore ti <hex:021A020203>soddisfa<hex:021A020103> pienamente? Capisco. Parlami pure di nuovo se cambiano le tue preferenze.

130.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_DUTY_FINDER_CONFIRM_REMAKE
130.description: Withdraw duty registration and review your retainer?
130.translation_description: Annullare la registrazione alla Ricerca Incarichi e rivedere il servitore?

131.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_REMAKE_TALK
131.description: Very well. First, let us review your retainer's current appearance. I must ask that you describe in detail which aspects you find unappealing, and what you would prefer.
131.translation_description: Benissimo. Per prima cosa esamineremo l'aspetto attuale del tuo servitore. Descrivimi nel dettaglio che cosa non ti piace e come vorresti che fosse.

132.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_PERSONALITY_TALK_REMAKE
132.description: I see... Next, I would have you confirm your preference with regards to personality. “The right retainer for the right person,” as we are wont to say.
132.translation_description: Capisco... Ora indicami le tue preferenze sulla personalità. Come si suol dire: «A ogni persona il servitore giusto».

133.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CHECK_PERSONALITY_REMAKE_ENTER
133.description: To ensure there is no misunderstanding, know that your retainer will address you just so:
133.translation_description: Per evitare equivoci, sappi che il tuo servitore ti rivolgerà questo saluto:

134.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CHECK_PERSONALITY_CONFIRM_REMAKE
134.description: Are you satisfied with this personality?
134.translation_description: Questa personalità è di tuo gradimento?

135.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_NAME_ASK_REMAKE
135.description: Understood. Finally, I must needs verify the nickname you would give your retainer. You may register the same nickname if you like.
135.translation_description: Capisco. Infine, devo verificare quale soprannome vorresti dare al tuo servitore. Se vuoi, puoi registrare lo stesso soprannome.

136.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CANCEL_CONFIRM_REMAKE
136.description: Are you certain you wish to cancel the review process?
136.translation_description: Sei sicuro di voler annullare la procedura di revisione?

138.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_REMEKE_RETAINER
138.description: One moment, please, while I draft the proper documentation.
138.translation_description: Un momento, per favore: preparo i documenti necessari.

139.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_EQUIP_HAVE_RETAINER
139.description: Forgive me, but you must first instruct your retainer to remove all equipment. A necessary precaution, in light of past incidents.
139.translation_description: Mi dispiace, ma prima devi chiedere al tuo servitore di togliere tutto l'equipaggiamento. È una precauzione necessaria, dopo alcuni incidenti passati.

140.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_VENTURE_RETAINER
140.description: Our records indicate that your retainer is currently undertaking a venture. Until that is no longer the case, I fear we cannot begin the review process.
140.translation_description: Dai nostri registri risulta che il tuo servitore è impegnato in una spedizione. Finché non sarà terminata, temo che non potremo avviare la revisione.

141.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_REMAKE_FAILED
141.description: Due to unforeseen circumstances, we cannot review your retainer at this time.
141.translation_description: Per circostanze impreviste, al momento non possiamo rivedere il tuo servitore.

142.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_REMAKE_SUCCESS_01
142.description: I am pleased to inform you that your review has been processed, and <hex:022903EA0203> is now ready to serve you.
142.translation_description: Ti comunico con piacere che la revisione è stata completata: <hex:022903EA0203> può tornare al servizio.

143.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_REMAKE_SUCCESS_02
143.description: You can summon your retainer using the nearby bell.
143.translation_description: Puoi evocare il tuo servitore usando la campanella qui vicino.

144.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_REMOVE_RETAINER_EXPLANATION
144.description: Very well. Allow me a moment to locate your documentation.
144.translation_description: Benissimo. Attendi un momento mentre recupero i tuoi documenti.

145.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_NO_RETAINERS_AVAILABLE
145.description: It does not appear you have any retainers in your employ at this time.
145.translation_description: Dai nostri registri risulta che al momento non hai servitori alle tue dipendenze.

146.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_REMOVE_RETAINER_TALK
146.description: Confirm the retainer you wish to release.

148.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ASK_REMOVE_HASHOUSE
148.description: Release <hex:022B09FF07022903EA020303>?<hex:02100103>Please be advised that retainers placed in estates will not be automatically removed.
148.translation_description: Congedare <hex:022B09FF07022903EA020303>?<hex:02100103>I servitori collocati nelle proprietà non verranno rimossi automaticamente.

151.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_REMOVE_SUCCESS
151.translation_description: Il contratto di <hex:022B09FF07022903EA020303> è stato rescisso.

152.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_REMOVE_FAILED_INVENTORY
152.description: Our records show that the retainer you wish to release is still in possession of several of your belongings, and may have placed a number of them for sale on the market.
152.translation_description: Dai nostri registri risulta che il servitore che vuoi congedare ha ancora con sé alcuni tuoi averi e potrebbe averne messi in vendita al mercato.

153.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_REMOVE_FAILED_INVENTORY2
153.description: You must retrieve those belongings before I can approve the dismissal.
153.translation_description: Devi recuperare quei beni prima che io possa approvare il congedo.

154.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_REMOVE_CANCEL
154.description: Understood. The retainer shall remain in your employ. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
154.translation_description: D'accordo. Il servitore resterà alle tue dipendenze. Parlami di nuovo se cambi idea.

155.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_JOB_MENU_TITLE
155.description: What would you like to do?

156.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_JOB_MENU_HOWTO
156.description: Ask about assigning your retainer a job.
156.translation_description: Informazioni sull'assegnazione di un job al servitore.

160.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_JOB_HOWTO_TALK_01
160.description: By popular demand, we have prepared an exhaustive publication to aid clients who would have their retainers train in certain ancient or esoteric traditions.
160.translation_description: Per rispondere alle numerose richieste, abbiamo preparato una guida completa per aiutare i clienti che desiderano addestrare i propri servitori in alcune discipline antiche o esoteriche.

161.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_JOB_HOWTO_TALK_02
161.description: To assign your retainer a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>job<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, you must first obtain <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>, which can be purchased from the retainer vocate for 40 ventures.
161.translation_description: Per assegnare al tuo servitore un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>job<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, devi prima procurarti <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>, acquistabile presso il mediatore dei servitori per 40 gettoni di spedizione.

162.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_JOB_HOWTO_TALK_03
162.description: Furthermore, you must have achieved level 50 in the job you wish to assign your retainer. Please note that the jobs you can assign your retainer are determined by their class. Limited jobs are not available.
162.translation_description: Inoltre, devi aver raggiunto il livello 50 nel job che vuoi assegnare al servitore. Ricorda che i job assegnabili dipendono dalla sua classe. I job limitati non sono disponibili.

163.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_JOB_HOWTO_TALK_04
163.description: If you wish to assign a level 50 retainer a job which is not currently available, you will need to reset and change their class.
163.translation_description: Se vuoi assegnare a un servitore di livello 50 un job che al momento non è disponibile, dovrai azzerarne la classe e sceglierne un'altra.

164.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RELATION_TALK_01
164.description: As you may know, a certain measure of experience is required before a retainer may train in a more advanced tradition.
164.translation_description: Come forse sai, per apprendere una disciplina più avanzata il servitore deve aver accumulato una certa esperienza.

168.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CONDITIONS_TALK_01
168.description: A retainer who has been assigned the <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103> class may be eligible to train in the following traditions:
168.translation_description: Un servitore assegnato alla classe <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103> può avere i requisiti per apprendere le seguenti discipline:

173.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CONDITIONS_TALK_20
173.description: To assign your retainer the <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103> job, you yourself must first achieve level 50 as <hex:>. Additionally, your retainer must have achieved level 50 as a Disciple of War or Magic.
173.translation_description: Per assegnare al tuo servitore il job <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103>, devi prima raggiungere il livello 50 come <hex:>. Inoltre, il servitore deve aver raggiunto il livello 50 come Discepolo della Guerra o della Magia.

174.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CONDITIONS_TALK_30
174.description: To assign your retainer the <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103> job, you yourself must first achieve level 60 as <hex:>. Additionally, your retainer must have achieved level 60 as a Disciple of War or Magic.
174.translation_description: Per assegnare al tuo servitore il job <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103>, devi prima raggiungere il livello 60 come <hex:>. Inoltre, il servitore deve aver raggiunto il livello 60 come Discepolo della Guerra o della Magia.

175.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CONDITIONS_TALK_40
175.description: To assign your retainer the <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103> job, you yourself must first achieve level 70 as <hex:>. Additionally, your retainer must have achieved level 70 as a Disciple of War or Magic.
175.translation_description: Per assegnare al tuo servitore il job <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103>, devi prima raggiungere il livello 70 come <hex:>. Inoltre, il servitore deve aver raggiunto il livello 70 come Discepolo della Guerra o della Magia.

176.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_CONDITIONS_TALK_50
176.description: To assign your retainer the <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103> job, you yourself must first achieve level 80 as <hex:>. Additionally, your retainer must have achieved level 80 as a Disciple of War or Magic.
176.translation_description: Per assegnare al tuo servitore il job <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103>, devi prima raggiungere il livello 80 come <hex:>. Inoltre, il servitore deve aver raggiunto il livello 80 come Discepolo della Guerra o della Magia.

177.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_SCROLL_HAS_ALREADY
177.description: Ahem. If I am not mistaken, do you not already have a copy of that publication in your possession?
177.translation_description: Ehm. Se non erro, non possiedi già una copia di quel manuale?

178.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_SCROLL_TALK_01
178.description: You already possess a copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Vocation<hex:021A020103>. You may summon a retainer and assign them a job, if they meet the necessary requirements.
178.translation_description: Possiedi già una copia di <hex:021A020203>Vocazione Moderna<hex:021A020103>. Puoi evocare un servitore e assegnargli un job, se soddisfa i requisiti necessari.

184.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_SCROLL_FULL_BAG
184.description: Unable to obtain <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>. Your inventory is full.

185.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_SCROLL_SHORTAGE_COIN
185.description: Unable to purchase <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>. You do not have enough ventures.
185.translation_description: Impossibile acquistare <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>. Non hai abbastanza gettoni di spedizione.

186.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_SCROLL_SHORTAGE_EXCHANGE_GUIDE
186.description: If you possess a venture promissory note, you may redeem it for ventures through a Calamity salvager.
186.translation_description: Se possiedi un buono per i gettoni di spedizione, puoi riscattarlo in cambio di gettoni da un Rigattiere della Calamità.

187.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_TRADE_TALK_01
187.translation_description: Hai scambiato 40 gettoni di spedizione per <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>.

188.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_TRADE_TALK_02
188.description: You may now summon a retainer and assign them a job, if they meet the necessary requirements.
188.translation_description: Ora puoi evocare un servitore e assegnargli un job, se soddisfa i requisiti necessari.

190.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE2
190.description: (-Rough Hyuran Male-)Nothin' fer ye to worry about.
190.translation_description: Non c'è niente di cui preoccuparsi.

192.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE4
192.description: (-Carefree Hyuran Male-)Yes? <sigh> I hope this doesn't take long...
192.translation_description: Sì? <sigh> Spero che non ci voglia molto...

193.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE5
193.description: (-Independent Hyuran Male-)You wish to see how a master handles a bazaar?
193.translation_description: Vuoi vedere come un maestro gestisce un bazar?

196.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE2
196.description: (-Rough Hyuran Female-)What's it to be this time, love?

198.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE4
198.description: (-Carefree Hyuran Female-)I'm so sorry to keep you waiting, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. So very, very sorry.
198.translation_description: Mi dispiace averti fatto aspettare, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>. Mi dispiace davvero, davvero tanto.

199.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
199.description: (-Independent Hyuran Female-)Quickly now, I've places to be.
199.translation_description: Facciamo in fretta, ho altri impegni.

200.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE6
200.description: (-Lively Hyuran Female-)Well, if it ain't my favorite client! Always a pleasure, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>!
200.translation_description: Ma guarda chi si vede, la mia persona preferita! È sempre un piacere, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>!

201.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE1
201.description: (-Polite Elezen Male-)Yes, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>? What is your bidding?

202.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
202.description: (-Rough Elezen Male-)What's on the agenda, chief? Deprivin' saps o' their hard-earned gil?
202.translation_description: Che si fa, capo? Si spillano gil ai gonzi?

203.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE3
203.description: (-Serious Elezen Male-)I have come. You may proceed.

204.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE4
204.description: (-Carefree Elezen Male-)Oh, hello there. To what do I owe the pleasure?
204.translation_description: Oh, salve. A cosa devo il piacere?

205.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE5
205.description: (-Independent Elezen Male-)I am come to conduct business, and only business.
205.translation_description: Sono qui per concludere affari, e solo affari.

206.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE6
206.description: (-Lively Elezen Male-)You look to be in good health, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. How may I assist you this fine <hex:02082EE3E90C0DFF14020810E3E90C05FF04657665FF056D6F726E03FF1302080FE3E90C12FF04646179FF046576650303>?

207.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE1
207.description: (-Polite Elezen Female-)What is it you would have me do, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>?
207.translation_description: Che cosa desidera che faccia per lei, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>?

208.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
208.description: (-Rough Elezen Female-)Usually, it's me doin' the summons and others doin' the waitin'.
208.translation_description: Di solito sono io a chiamare gli altri e loro a farsi attendere.

209.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE3
209.description: (-Serious Elezen Female-)Is there something that I can help you with?
209.translation_description: C'è qualcosa in cui posso aiutarti?

210.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
210.description: (-Carefree Elezen Female-)Oh, why must you summon me at a time like this...?
210.translation_description: Perché mi evochi sempre nei momenti meno opportuni...?

211.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
211.description: (-Independent Elezen Female-)I'm sure there is a perfectly good explanation for this summons.
211.translation_description: Sono certa che ci sia un validissimo motivo per cui mi hai chiamata.

212.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE6
212.description: (-Lively Elezen Female-)You know, I thought you might be along to summon me. You may rest assured that I am ready and eager to serve.
212.translation_description: Sai, ero certa che prima o poi mi avresti evocata. Sono pronta e impaziente di servirti.

213.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
213.description: (-Polite Lalafellin Male-)Hail to thee, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. Your humble servant has heard your summons.
213.translation_description: Salute a te, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>. Il tuo umile servitore ha udito la tua chiamata.

214.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE2
214.description: (-Rough Lalafellin Male-)Greetin's and salutations, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>. Pray speak yer desires, an' I'll do me damndest to see 'em done.
214.translation_description: Salve, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>. Dimmi cosa desideri e farò del mio meglio per accontentarti.

215.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE3
215.description: (-Serious Lalafellin Male-)I was wondering when you'd get around to calling me.
215.translation_description: Mi chiedevo quando ti saresti deciso a chiamarmi.

216.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
216.description: (-Carefree Lalafellin Male-)Mind if we keep this brief? I've got a pretty little thing that's waitin' for me.
216.translation_description: Ti dispiace se facciamo in fretta? C'è una graziosa fanciulla che mi aspetta.

219.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE1
219.description: (-Polite Lalafellin Female-)Here I am, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>, as per your request.

220.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE2
220.description: (-Rough Lalafellin Female-)'Ello, dearie. What's on the docket?
220.translation_description: Salve, cara. Che cosa c'è in programma?

221.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
221.description: (-Serious Lalafellin Female-)I never miss a chance to line these pockets.
221.translation_description: Non perdo mai un'occasione per riempirmi le tasche.

222.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
222.description: (-Carefree Lalafellin Female-)Well, this is unexpected! What'll it be?
222.translation_description: Questa sì che è una sorpresa! Che si fa?

225.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE1
225.description: (-Polite Miqo'te Male-)How may I be of serrrvice, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>?

226.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE2
226.description: (-Rough Miqo'te Male-)It's a war out there, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. You have no idea.
226.translation_description: Là fuori è una guerra, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503>. Non hai idea.

229.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
229.description: (-Independent Miqo'te Male-)I presume you did not summon me solely for the pleasure of my company.
229.translation_description: Immagino che il piacere della mia compagnia non sia l'unico motivo per cui hai suonato la campanella.

230.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
230.description: (-Lively Miqo'te Male-)Just the <hex:020821E905FF0C66616972206D616964656EFF1068616E64736F6D652066656C6C6F7703> I was hoping to see! Tell me your heart's desire.
230.translation_description: Proprio <hex:02082AE905FF136C612062656C6C612066616E6369756C6C61FF12696C2062656C2067696F76616E6F74746F03> che speravo di incontrare! Dimmi qual è il tuo desiderio più grande.

231.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE1
231.description: (-Polite Miqo'te Female-)I hope your catcall is not one of disapproval.
231.translation_description: Spero che quel tuo richiamo da gattaro non sia un segno di disapprovazione.

233.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE3
233.description: (-Serious Miqo'te Female-)A cat's ears do not miss much―least of all a summons.
233.translation_description: Le orecchie di un gatto non si lasciano sfuggire molto, men che meno una chiamata.

234.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
234.description: (-Carefree Miqo'te Female-)Curiosity called the cat. What do you have for me today?
234.translation_description: La curiosità ha richiamato il gatto. Che cosa hai per me oggi?

236.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
236.description: (-Lively Miqo'te Female-)I was just thinking of you!

237.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
237.description: (-Polite Roegadyn Male-)What need have you of me today, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>?
237.translation_description: Di che cosa hai bisogno oggi, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>?

238.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE2
238.description: (-Rough Roegadyn Male-)Bwahahaha! Ye got work needs gettin' done? Just point me in the right bloody direction.
238.translation_description: Bwahahaha! C'è del lavoro da sbrigare? Indicami la direzione e ci penso io, maledizione!

239.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE3
239.description: (-Serious Roegadyn Male-)I've come. What is it?

240.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
240.description: (-Carefree Roegadyn Male-)Hey there─hic─<hex:020810E905FF066D69737379FF056D61746503>! Care to join me fer a pint?
240.translation_description: Ehi─hic─<hex:020811E905FF0662656C6C61FF06616D69636F03>! Ti va di bere una pinta?

241.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE5
241.description: (-Independent Roegadyn Male-)Couldn't come no quicker. Where's the work?
241.translation_description: Non potevo arrivare prima. Dov'è il lavoro?

242.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
242.description: (-Lively Roegadyn Male-)I came runnin' soon as I heard the bell! Ye need somethin', chief?
242.translation_description: Sono corso qui appena ho sentito la campanella! Ti serve qualcosa, capo?

243.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE1
243.description: (-Polite Roegadyn Female-)I am at your disposal, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.

244.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE2
244.description: (-Rough Roegadyn Female-)Ye got somethin' fer me, cap'n?

246.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
246.description: (-Carefree Roegadyn Female-)Let's keep this short and sweet, shall we?
246.translation_description: Facciamola breve e indolore, va bene?

247.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
247.description: (-Independent Roegadyn Female-)This wouldn't be necessary if you entrusted your financial affairs to me.
247.translation_description: Non sarebbe necessario se mi affidassi la gestione delle tue finanze.

248.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE6
248.description: (-Lively Roegadyn Female-)So─sellin', buyin', drinkin', whorin'? What's it to be today?
248.translation_description: Oggi si vende, si compra, si beve o si va a puttane? Che si fa?

249.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
249.description: (-Polite Auri Male-)Greetings, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. How may I be of service?

252.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
252.description: (-Carefree Auri Male-)And how does this wonderful <hex:020835E3E90C0DFF17020813E3E90C05FF086576656E696E67FF0464617903FF17020813E3E90C12FF04646179FF086576656E696E670303> find you?

254.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
254.description: (-Lively Auri Male-)We work the market stalls,♪<hex:02100103>And our uniforms are pretty;♪<hex:02100103>We are sober men and true,♪<hex:02100103>And attentive to our duties!♪
254.translation_description: Vendiamo ai banchi del mercato,♪<hex:02100103>Le uniformi son graziose,♪<hex:02100103>Siamo uomini seri e fidati,♪<hex:02100103>E solerti nei nostri doveri!♪

255.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE1
255.description: (-Polite Auri Female-)<hex:020815E905FF084D79206C616479FF084D79206C6F726403>. What would you ask of me?

258.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
258.description: (-Carefree Auri Female-)Hey, it's...it's you! Hello again, you!
258.translation_description: Ehi, ma... sei tu! Ciao, ciao!

259.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
259.description: (-Independent Auri Female-)I-It's not like I want to sell your items or anything.
259.translation_description: Non è che voglia vendere i tuoi oggetti o roba del genere.

260.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
260.description: (-Lively Auri Female-)What do you have for me? Come on, come on! Don't be shy!
260.translation_description: Che cosa hai per me? Dai, dai! Non fare complimenti!

262.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE2
262.description: (-Rough Hrothgar Male-)I trust this will be worth my while.
262.translation_description: Spero che ne valga la pena.

264.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE4
264.description: (-Carefree Hrothgar Male-)Whatever you need, leave it to me! I have my methods.
264.translation_description: Qualunque cosa ti serva, ci penso io! Ho i miei metodi.

265.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE5
265.description: (-Independent Hrothgar Male-)Gahaha! If it isn't my favorite <hex:020815E905FF096D69737472657373FF076D617374657203>!
265.translation_description: Ahahaha! Ma guarda chi si vede, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>!

266.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE6
266.description: (-Lively Hrothgar Male-)It is I, your most loyal and capable retainer!
266.translation_description: Eccomi, il tuo servitore più fedele e capace!

267.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE1
267.description: (-Polite Viera Female-)What will it be, love?

268.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE2
268.description: (-Rough Viera Female-)Your orders! I would hear them at once!
268.translation_description: Ai tuoi ordini! Dimmi subito cosa vuoi!

269.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE3
269.description: (-Serious Viera Female-)If there is something you would ask of me, then ask it.
269.translation_description: Se hai qualcosa da chiedermi, chiedi pure.

270.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE4
270.description: (-Carefree Viera Female-)Yes...? Is there something you─<yawn>─need?

271.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE5
271.description: (-Independent Viera Female-)A task for me? I hope it's something fun!
271.translation_description: Un incarico per me? Spero sia qualcosa di divertente!

272.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE6
272.description: (-Lively Viera Female-)I am here to do your every bidding, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>! Ask of me anything at all!
272.translation_description: Sono qui per esaudire ogni desiderio di <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>! Mi chieda pure qualsiasi cosa!

273.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_VIERA_MALE_TYPE1
273.description: (-Polite Viera Male-)I have been awaiting your summons, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. What would you have of me this fine <hex:020839E3E90C0DFF1B020817E3E90C05FF086576656E696E67FF086D6F726E696E6703FF17020813E3E90C12FF04646179FF086576656E696E670303>?
273.translation_description: Attendevo la chiamata di <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>. Che cosa desidera in questa splendida <hex:02083EE3E90C0DFF1C020818E3E90C05FF07736572617461FF0A6D617474696E61746103FF1B020817E3E90C12FF0967696F726E617461FF077365726174610303>?

274.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_VIERA_MALE_TYPE2
274.description: (-Rough Viera Male-)What can I do for ye, yer <hex:020817E905FF096C61647973686970FF096C6F72647368697003>?

277.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_VIERA_MALE_TYPE5
277.description: (-Independent Viera Male-)Need my assistance, do you? Let's make this quick, then.
277.translation_description: Ti serve il mio aiuto? Allora facciamo in fretta.

278.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_VIERA_MALE_TYPE6
278.description: (-Lively Viera Male-)You have my ear, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>. Both of them, in fact!

280.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE2
280.description: (-Rough Hrothgar Female-)At your beck an' call, I am!

281.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE3
281.description: (-Serious Hrothgar Female-)You called, and I have come.

282.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE4
282.description: (-Carefree Hrothgar Female-)At last─I thought you'd <hex:021A020203>never<hex:021A020103> call. What does <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403> need of me?
282.translation_description: Alla buon'ora─credevo che <hex:021A020203>non mi avresti mai<hex:021A020103> chiamata! Che cosa desidera da me, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>?

283.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE5
283.description: (-Independent Hrothgar Female-)Could it be...? The famous <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> has called on <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>? <chuckle>
283.translation_description: Possibile...? La persona più famosa, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, ha chiamato proprio <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>? <chuckle>

284.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE6
284.description: (-Lively Hrothgar Female-)Yes, yes, here I am! Ready at a moment's notice!

285.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE1
285.description: (-Polite Hyuran Male-)If that is all, I will take my leave now, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>.
285.translation_description: Se non ha altro da chiedermi, mi congedo, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>.

286.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE2
286.description: (-Rough Hyuran Male-)Take care o' yerself, hear?

288.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE4
288.description: (-Carefree Hyuran Male-)Well, it's about time. Good-bye.

289.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE5
289.description: (-Independent Hyuran Male-)I believe thanks are in order.
289.translation_description: Direi che mi devi un ringraziamento.

292.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE2
292.description: (-Rough Hyuran Female-)Don't you worry 'bout a thing. I got this.
292.translation_description: Non preoccuparti di nulla. Ci penso io.

294.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE4
294.description: (-Carefree Hyuran Female-)If there is nothing else, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, I'll be going now.
294.translation_description: Se non ha altro, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>, mi congedo.

295.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
295.description: (-Independent Hyuran Female-)Is that all? Very well, until next time.
295.translation_description: Tutto qui? Va bene, alla prossima.

296.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE6
296.description: (-Lively Hyuran Female-)Oh, will that be all today? Very well, but promise me you'll come back soon!
296.translation_description: È tutto per oggi? Va bene, ma promettimi che tornerai presto!

297.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE1
297.description: (-Polite Elezen Male-)As always, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, it has been an honor and a privilege.
297.translation_description: Come sempre, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>, è stato un onore e un privilegio.

298.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
298.description: (-Rough Elezen Male-)You can count on me, chief─I know how to get things done.
298.translation_description: Puoi contare su di me, capo: so come si portano a termine gli incarichi.

300.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE4
300.description: (-Carefree Elezen Male-)I swear it shall be done. Eventually.

302.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE6
302.description: (-Lively Elezen Male-)Capital! I shall carry out your orders forthwith.
302.translation_description: Magnifico! Eseguirò subito i tuoi ordini.

303.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE1
303.description: (-Polite Elezen Female-)I humbly await your next summons, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.
303.translation_description: Attenderò con impazienza la prossima chiamata di <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>.

304.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
304.description: (-Rough Elezen Female-)Don't leave me alone for too long, hear?
304.translation_description: Non lasciarmi sola troppo a lungo, capito?

306.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
306.description: (-Carefree Elezen Female-)That will be all, yes? Then if you would excuse me...
306.translation_description: È tutto, vero? Allora, se vuoi scusarmi...

307.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
307.description: (-Independent Elezen Female-)I believe that concludes our dealings for now.
307.translation_description: Per ora abbiamo concluso i nostri affari.

308.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE6
308.description: (-Lively Elezen Female-)Are you certain you don't desire anything else? Anything at all? Very well, I shall take my leave.
308.translation_description: Non desideri altro? Nulla? D'accordo, mi congedo.

309.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
309.description: (-Polite Lalafellin Male-)Your every whim shall be swiftly carried out with due care and consideration.
309.translation_description: Ogni tuo desiderio verrà esaudito in breve tempo, con cura e premura.

310.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE2
310.description: (-Rough Lalafellin Male-)Shouldn't take more than a moment, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.

312.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
312.description: (-Carefree Lalafellin Male-)Thank the gods we're finished. I've got plans to put my hands in places I've never seen...if you know what I mean.
312.translation_description: Per fortuna abbiamo finito! Ho in programma di mettere le mani in posti che non ho mai visto... se capisci cosa intendo.

316.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE2
316.description: (-Rough Lalafellin Female-)Blessin's o' the Twelve upon ye.

317.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
317.description: (-Serious Lalafellin Female-)May Nald'thal see fit to fatten our pockets!
317.translation_description: Possa Nald'thal aiutarci a riempire le tasche!

318.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
318.description: (-Carefree Lalafellin Female-)Very good, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>! Your wish is my command, and so forth.
318.translation_description: Benissimo, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>! I suoi desideri sono ordini, e così via.

319.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE5
319.description: (-Independent Lalafellin Female-)You know how to reach me.

320.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE6
320.description: (-Lively Lalafellin Female-)Is it time for good-byes already? I'm going to miss you...
320.translation_description: È già ora di salutarci? Mi mancherai...

322.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE2
322.description: (-Rough Miqo'te Male-)The markets may be a bleedin' battlefield, but I'm a godsdamned soldier. You can count on me, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.
322.translation_description: I mercati saranno anche un campo di battaglia, ma io sono un soldato, dannazione. Conta su di me, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>.

324.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE4
324.description: (-Carefree Miqo'te Male-)Why so serrrious? <sigh> So it goes.
324.translation_description: Perché fai tanto sul serio? <sigh> Che vuoi farci.

325.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
325.description: (-Independent Miqo'te Male-)I hardly think that warranted my personal appearance, but what is done is done.
325.translation_description: Non mi sembra che valesse la pena convocarmi di persona, ma ormai è andata.

326.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
326.description: (-Lively Miqo'te Male-)Then I have satisfied your every need? Excellent! I do so take pleasure in servicing my clients.
326.translation_description: Ho soddisfatto ogni tua esigenza? Ottimo! Mi piace molto servire i miei clienti.

328.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE2
328.description: (-Rough Miqo'te Female-)Right then, let's get on with it!

329.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE3
329.description: (-Serious Miqo'te Female-)There is no call for concerrrn.

330.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
330.description: (-Carefree Miqo'te Female-)When the master's away, the cat will play.
330.translation_description: Quando il padrone non c'è, il gatto si diverte.

332.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
332.description: (-Lively Miqo'te Female-)You don't want to be with me anymore? <sniffle>
332.translation_description: Non vuoi più stare con me? <sniffle>

333.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
333.description: (-Polite Roegadyn Male-)I shall carry out your wishes as instructed, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

334.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE2
334.description: (-Rough Roegadyn Male-)Bwahahaha! I'm in yer bazaar, sellin' yer wares!
334.translation_description: Bwahahaha! Eccomi al tuo bazar, a vendere la tua merce!

336.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
336.description: (-Carefree Roegadyn Male-)Awww, bugger. Reckon I best get to work...
336.translation_description: Awww, dannazione. Mi sa che mi tocca mettermi al lavoro...

338.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
338.description: (-Lively Roegadyn Male-)Go and grab yourself some shut-eye, chief. You look terrible!
338.translation_description: Vai a dormire un po', capo. Hai una pessima cera!

339.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE1
339.description: (-Polite Roegadyn Female-)Will that be all for today, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>? Understood.

342.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
342.description: (-Carefree Roegadyn Female-)Not exactly how I was hopin' to spend my day, but I suppose it can't be helped.
342.translation_description: Non era proprio così che speravo di trascorrere la giornata, ma non posso farci niente.

343.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
343.description: (-Independent Roegadyn Female-)Ours is not to reason why. Ours is but to do and die.
343.translation_description: Non sta a noi chiederci perché: il nostro compito è agire e morire.

344.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE6
344.description: (-Lively Roegadyn Female-)Ever the consummate professional, I see. Another time, then.
344.translation_description: Sempre una professionista impeccabile, vedo. Alla prossima.

345.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
345.description: (-Polite Auri Male-)If there is nothing else, then I shall take my leave.
345.translation_description: Se non hai altro da chiedermi, mi congedo.

346.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE2
346.description: (-Rough Auri Male-)Is that all? Guess I'll be on my way, then.

347.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE3
347.description: (-Serious Auri Male-)Any last requests? Very well. Heh heh heh... Ahem.
347.translation_description: Hai altre richieste? Bene. Heh heh heh... Ehm.

348.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
348.description: (-Carefree Auri Male-)Ah, yes, of course. Duty calls!
348.translation_description: Ah, sì, certo. Il dovere mi chiama!

349.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE5
349.description: (-Independent Auri Male-)You are finished with me, then?

350.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
350.description: (-Lively Auri Male-)Here today and gone tomorrow;♪<hex:02100103>Yes, I know─♪<hex:02100103>That is so!♪
350.translation_description: Qui oggi e domani chissà;♪<hex:02100103>Lo so già─♪<hex:02100103>È proprio così!♪

351.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE1
351.description: (-Polite Auri Female-)If ever you have need of me, just ring.
351.translation_description: Se hai bisogno di me, chiamami pure.

354.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
354.description: (-Carefree Auri Female-)Finished already? Guess that's that, then.

355.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
355.description: (-Independent Auri Female-)You're leaving already? Fine, then! I-It's not like I wanted you to stay or anything.
355.translation_description: Te ne vai già? Va bene! N-Non è che volessi che restassi o altro!

356.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
356.description: (-Lively Auri Female-)Very good, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>! Very good indeed!

357.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE1
357.description: (-Polite Hrothgar Male-)Always a pleasure to serve, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.

358.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE2
358.description: (-Rough Hrothgar Male-)Hmph. I hope that next time you will have a more meaningful task for me.
358.translation_description: Hmph. La prossima volta spero che tu mi affidi un compito più interessante.

360.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE4
360.description: (-Carefree Hrothgar Male-)And with that, I shall be off. Places to go, people to see.
360.translation_description: Allora vado. Ho posti da visitare e persone da incontrare.

361.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE5
361.description: (-Indepedent Hrothgar Male-)Bahahaha! Till next time, my friend!

362.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE6
362.description: (-Lively Hrothgar Male-)Ring for me whenever you please! You know that I will never let you down!
362.translation_description: Chiamami quando vuoi! Sai che non ti deluderò mai!

363.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE1
363.description: (-Polite Viera Female-)Must we part so soon?

365.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE3
365.description: (-Serious Viera Female-)Call on me as you please. If I am so inclined, I will answer.
365.translation_description: Chiamami pure. Se ne avrò voglia, risponderò.

366.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE4
366.description: (-Carefree Viera Female-)That is all, I suppose...? <yawn> Very well...

367.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE5
367.description: (-Indepedent Viera Female-)That is all? Oh, I was hoping there'd be more...
367.translation_description: Tutto qui? Oh, speravo ci fosse dell'altro...

368.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE6
368.description: (-Lively Viera Female-)Is that all you need of me? But I could yet serve you in so many ways!
368.translation_description: È tutto ciò che ti serve da me? Potrei servirti ancora in tanti modi!

369.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE1
369.description: (-Polite Viera Male-)Do not hesitate to call upon me again. Fare you well in your endeavors, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.
369.translation_description: Non esiti a chiamarmi di nuovo. Le auguro buona fortuna nelle sue imprese, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>.

370.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE2
370.description: (-Rough Viera Male-)Just say the word, yer <hex:020817E905FF096C61647973686970FF096C6F72647368697003>, and I'll be here with bells on.

371.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE3
371.description: (-Serious Viera Male-)If you have no further need of my services...
371.translation_description: Se non hai più bisogno dei miei servizi...

372.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE4
372.description: (-Carefree Viera Male-)I'm off for another glass, then. You know where to find me!
372.translation_description: Ora vado a bermi un altro bicchiere. Sai dove trovarmi!

373.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE5
373.description: (-Independent Viera Male-)What─is that it? Are you <hex:021A020203>sure<hex:021A020103> you need a retainer?

374.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE6
374.description: (-Lively Viera Male-)Nothing else? Then I shall be hopping along.
374.translation_description: Nient'altro? Allora me ne vado saltellando!

375.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE1
375.description: (-Polite Hrothgar Female-)I'm glad to have been of service. Mind you don't overdo things, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.
375.translation_description: Sono lieta di esserle stata utile. Non si affatichi troppo, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>.

376.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE2
376.description: (-Rough Hrothgar Female-)Had your fill of me, eh? Fair enough! Let me know if you need aught else!
376.translation_description: Ne hai avuto abbastanza di me, eh? D'accordo! Fammi sapere se ti serve altro!

377.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE3
377.description: (-Serious Hrothgar Female-)We're done? Then I take my leave.

378.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE4
378.description: (-Carefree Hrothgar Female-)There's naught else <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403> requires? I'll be sharpening my claws, then, waiting for your next summons.
378.translation_description: Non ha bisogno di altro, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>? Allora affilo gli artigli e attendo la sua prossima chiamata.

379.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE5
379.description: (-Independent Hrothgar Female-)Nothing else? Right... I'll be off!

380.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE6
380.description: (-Lively Hrothgar Female-)Have everything you need? I'll take a little nap, then.
380.translation_description: Hai tutto ciò che ti serve? Allora farò un pisolino.

381.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_ORDER_FAILED_NO_CHARGE
381.description: You cannot perform this action until you have purchased the services of an additional retainer.
381.translation_description: Non puoi compiere questa azione finché non avrai assunto un servitore aggiuntivo.

382.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_REMOVE_INVENTORY_EXPLANATION
382.description: You cannot release retainers while they are in possession of any items or gil.
382.translation_description: Non puoi congedare i servitori che hanno con sé oggetti o gil.

383.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_MAIN_MENU_EXPLANATION_01
383.description: What would you like to know?

384.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_REMOVE_FAILED
384.description: You were unable to release that retainer.
384.translation_description: Non è stato possibile congedare il servitore.

385.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_CREATE_FAILED
385.description: Your application for a retainer was denied.
385.translation_description: La tua richiesta di assumere un servitore è stata respinta.

386.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_CALL_FAILED
386.description: Your retainer could not be summoned.

387.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_REGISTER_MARKET_FAILED
387.description: The retainer was unable to make the trip.
387.translation_description: Il servitore non è riuscito a raggiungere la destinazione.

388.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_NAME_TOO_SHORT
388.description: Nicknames must be between 3 and 20 characters.
388.translation_description: Il soprannome deve contenere da 3 a 20 caratteri.

389.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERDESK_00009_RETAINER_CONTRACT_ENDED
389.description: This retainer's contract has been suspended.
389.translation_description: Il contratto di questo servitore è stato sospeso.
